name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Revenue Operations | Pipeline Process, Sales Policy, CRM Systems & Clear Documentation
summary: Revenue operations builder who spent a decade on the quota side first. I ranked top three on a B2B SaaS sales team at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, sold into commission accelerator tiers, and helped leadership build the lead qualification system, so I know how pipeline stages, bookings, and comp plans actually change rep behavior. Today I design CRM systems, lifecycle stages, scoring, routing, and the documentation that lets a team run them, and I build models and dashboards in Excel, Power BI, and SQL.
